name: qlrisk_frtb_ima_capital
title: FRTB Internal Models Approach capital
description: FRTB IMA capital (MAR31/33). mode='full' runs the book end to end: liquidity-horizon-adjusted, stress-calibrated ES and IMCC, stressed ES for non-modellable factors (nmrf), the IMA default risk charge (two-factor Gaussian copula, from ratings) and capital = max(IMCC + SES, m x avg60) + DRC. Other modes: 'imcc', 'lh_es' (liquidity-adjusted ES only), 'liquidity_horizons' (MAR33.12 horizon per factor), 'rfet' (risk-factor eligibility test on real-price observation dates), 'ima_drc' (on positions you supply) and 'capital' (from IMCC, SES and DRC numbers). Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, current_window, stress_window, rho, revaluation, reduced_set, liquidity_horizons, nmrf, idiosyncratic, ratings, seniority, multiplier, small_caps, high_yield, as_of, observations, drc_positions, n_sims, global_correlation, sector_correlation, sectors, seed, imcc, ses, drc, imcc_avg60, ses_avg60, es_confidence_pct, drc_confidence_pct) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "mode": "imcc"} gives IMCC 29,681.72 USD (stress window 2024-10-07 to 2025-09-19, ratio 1.00) on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
